good: Strong speed sense: boost blur, FOV push, a 300 km/h readout and a flame trail
Burnout-style HUD: big position, boost bar with colour change, takedown counter, DRIFT text and a TAKEDOWN! card
The track mixes a city, a coastal cliff and a tunnel, and the trailer shows takedowns, drift and boost
bad: The automatic check failed on auto-steer. W-only driving still ended in crashes and walls, and the steering tests mostly produced CRASHED screens, so the car is hard to control
Frequent crashes: the car flips at about 10 km/h and respawns again and again, which hurts fun. The player sat in 8th for most of the run
The art is low-poly and blocky: the city is a wall of flat windowed boxes, and the cars and scenery look basic
sonnet-5.5-xhigh.one_line: It looks fast and the HUD and takedown card are punchy, but the car flips over too easily and the low-poly world feels cheap, so it's a flashy but crash-heavy Burnout knockoff.

good: Boost flames, blur and drift smoke communicate speed.
City, coastal bends and a lit tunnel provide variety.
Readable HUD and bold takedown cards capture Burnout's style.
bad: Confirmed auto-steer undermines driving through bends.
Repeated rollovers interrupt ordinary steering inputs.
Repetitive buildings and angular scenery limit visual quality.
gpt-6.1-sol-xhigh.one_line: The boost and takedown presentation look fun, but automatic cornering and constant flipping spoil the driving.

good: Burnout-style HUD is strong: position 8TH/8, lap+time, takedowns, big speed readout, segmented boost bar, minimap, DRIFT/+BOOST/CRASHED callouts
Trailer shows the game well: grid start with rivals, red TAKEDOWN! x3 card, 300+ km/h boost flames, drift smoke, tunnel and coastal sections
Track has variety (city grid, cliff/coast, tunnel) with wide two-lane road, chevrons, guardrails and no traffic
bad: Auto-steer: the car follows the road's bends with only W held (check fail) - player never has to steer, brief violated
Walls are lethal at walking speed: repeated low-speed flips (8-11 km/h) with CRASHED, so the scripted drive never finishes lap 1 and stays 8th
Flat low-poly art with no visible shadows, motion blur or speed effects; scenery is simple cones and flat planes
minimax-m3.1-flash-free.one_line: Solid low-poly racer with a genuinely Burnout-like HUD and a good trailer, but the car steers itself through the bends and flips over every time it grazes a wall.
